components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Confirm-green pressable capsule for Continue and other go actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 10rem; height: 3.25rem; padding: 0 1.75rem; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-accent, #15803d); color: var(--color-card, #ffffff); font-family: Rubik, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 0 var(--color-accent-deep, #116232); transition: transform 100ms, box-shadow 100ms, background-color 100ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-accent-deep, #116232); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(4px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 var(--color-accent-deep, #116232); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent, #15803d); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: White Card Back/Cancel capsule with a Grove Line stroke and matching 4px edge.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 3.25rem; padding: 0 1.75rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-line, #cdd9cf); border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--color-card, #ffffff); color: var(--color-mute, #4b5e52); font-family: Rubik, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; box-shadow: 0 4px 0 0 var(--color-line, #cdd9cf); transition: transform 100ms, box-shadow 100ms, color 100ms; cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { color: var(--color-ink, #0f1a12); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(4px); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 var(--color-line, #cdd9cf); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--color-accent, #15803d); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.css: .ds-compose { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.75rem; border-radius: 1.5rem 0.5rem 1.5rem 1.5rem; border: 2px solid var(--color-line, #cdd9cf); background: var(--color-card, #ffffff); padding: 1.25rem 1.5rem; font-family: Rubik, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-compose:focus-within { border-color: var(--color-accent, #15803d); } .ds-ksh { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 800; color: var(--color-accent, #15803d); } .ds-field { display: block; width: 100%; border: 0; background: transparent; padding: 0; font: inherit; font-size: 3.5rem; line-height: 1; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: -0.03em; color: var(--color-ink, #0f1a12); font-feature-settings: "tnum"; caret-color: var(--color-accent, #15803d); outline: none; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: var(--color-hint, #66796c); opacity: 1; }

narrative.overview:
Ghunami drafts a fundraiser the way money already moves in Kenya: a thread of messages that ends in a confirmation. The screen is a pale green-gray chat, not a gray form. ghunami asks from the left in white incoming bubbles, with the Horizon mark sitting in a dark disc as the avatar. Your answers leave as confirm-green sent bubbles. Review reads back as a receipt: dashed rows, tabular numerals, a green tick.

The material is fat and tactile. Actions are fully rounded pills with a solid darker bottom edge that presses in. One self-hosted face (Rubik, 300–900) carries every role; size does the talking. The name **ghunami** (lowercase in the wordmark; Ghunami in titles) and the Horizon mark (rising semicircle over two receding bands) are binding identity.
keyCharacteristics: Pale green-gray paper with white speech surfaces and confirm-green sent answers
One face, hierarchy by size; labels shout with uppercase and extra-bold
Chat tails: large radius with one tighter corner toward the speaker
Green means go or done; red is reserved for errors

rules.name: The Palette Law
rules.body: Green is go and done. Red is error only. Do not invent a third accent.

rules.name: The Confirmation Field Rule
rules.body: A sent answer and a live primary action share Confirm Green. If it is not an answer, a progress fill, or a go-control, it is not green.

rules.name: The One Face Rule
rules.body: Rubik for display, body, UI, and numerals. Change size and case; do not add a display serif or a mono.

rules.name: The Pressable Edge Rule
rules.body: A live primary or secondary action carries a 4px solid bottom edge in the matching deep/line color. Disabled primaries lose the edge and sit on Grove Line.

dos: Do keep the Horizon mark and the name ghunami on every surface that represents the product.
Do put go/done/sent/progress on Confirm Green, and press travel on a 4px edge.
Do give speech surfaces a 24px round and one 8px tail toward the speaker.
Do set money and questions extra-bold, with tabular numerals on amounts.
Do dock Continue/Back as pressable capsules on paper, and disable Continue on Grove Line with no edge.
donts: Don't use Signal Red for anything but an error message.
Don't add a second typeface or a decorative italic.
Don't use ambient drop shadows to lift cards; the edge and the paper are the depth.
Don't turn a compose well into a gray Material field with its own inner border and ring.
Don't replace the Horizon disc with a generic initials avatar.
